ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a DC regulated power supply circuit, with the left-side input being U1=18V, passing through the three-terminal regulator CW7805. Pin 1 of CW7805 is connected to the input terminal, pin 3 is connected to the right-side output node UO, and pin 2 is the common/reference terminal. Between the right-side output node and ground, R1=500Ω and R2=1kΩ form a series voltage divider, and the midpoint of R1 and R2 is connected to one input terminal of the operational amplifier. Between the output node UO and the pin 2 reference node of CW7805, there is also an equal-value voltage divider composed of R3=2kΩ and R4=2kΩ, and the midpoint of the two is connected to the other input terminal of the operational amplifier. The output terminal has a 0.1μF capacitor connected in parallel to ground, which can be ignored in DC analysis. Reasoning: Let the voltage of the pin 2 reference/common terminal of CW7805 be Vref. From the R1-R2 voltage divider, the positive input voltage of the operational amplifier is V+ = UO × R2/(R1+R2) = UO × 1000/(500+1000) = (2/3)UO. From the R3-R4 equal-value voltage divider, the negative input voltage of the operational amplifier is V− = (UO + Vref)/2. Under negative feedback of the operational amplifier, approximately V+ = V− is satisfied, so (2/3)UO = (UO + Vref)/2, solving gives Vref = UO/3. CW7805 maintains the output terminal at 5V relative to its common terminal, that is, UO − Vref = 5V. Therefore UO − UO/3 = 5V, (2/3)UO = 5V, obtaining UO = 7.5V.

raw_record.question_text: What is the output voltage \(U_O\) in the DC regulated power supply circuit shown in the figure?

method.method_draft: First describe the image connections: identify the CW7805, the output node UO, the regulator common/reference node at pin 2, the R1-R2 divider to ground, and the equal R3-R4 divider between UO and the reference node. For DC, ignore the output capacitor. Let the regulator reference/common pin voltage be Vref. From the R1-R2 divider, the op-amp + input is V+ = UO * R2/(R1+R2) = UO * 1000/(500+1000) = (2/3)UO. From the equal R3-R4 divider, the op-amp − input is V− = (UO + Vref)/2. Apply virtual short V+ = V− to get (2/3)UO = (UO + Vref)/2, hence Vref = UO/3. Apply the CW7805 regulation condition UO − Vref = 5 V, so UO − UO/3 = 5 V, giving UO = 7.5 V.

图像描述：图中是一个直流稳压电源电路，左侧输入为 U1=18V，经过三端稳压器 CW7805。CW7805 的 1 脚接输入端，3 脚接右侧输出节点 UO，2 脚是公共/参考端。右侧输出节点到地之间有 R1=500Ω 与 R2=1kΩ 串联分压，R1、R2 的中点接到运放的一个输入端。输出节点 UO 与 CW7805 的 2 脚参考节点之间还有 R3=2kΩ、R4=2kΩ 组成的等值分压，二者中点接到运放的另一输入端。输出端并联有 0.1μF 电容到地，直流分析时可忽略。

推理：设 CW7805 的 2 脚参考/公共端电压为 Vref。由 R1-R2 分压，运放正输入电压为 V+ = UO × R2/(R1+R2) = UO × 1000/(500+1000) = (2/3)UO。由 R3-R4 等值分压，运放负输入电压为 V− = (UO + Vref)/2。运放负反馈下近似满足 V+ = V−，所以 (2/3)UO = (UO + Vref)/2，解得 Vref = UO/3。CW7805 保持输出端相对其公共端为 5V，即 UO − Vref = 5V。因此 UO − UO/3 = 5V，(2/3)UO = 5V，得到 UO = 7.5V。
